name: cambio
description: Online real-time Cambio card game (responsive web)

scripts.dev: trap 'kill 0' EXIT; npm run dev:party & npm run dev:client
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@cambio/shared && npm run build --workspace=@cambio/engine
scripts.deploy: npm run build --workspace=@cambio/client && cd party && npx partykit deploy
